standard-dialogue-without-a-catspeak-amu.text: He appears to be sleeping peacefully, so you decide to leave him be.

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.text: (Dialogue continues with the current response, starting with 1.)

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.npc: Hi [player name]. You woke me up, I was fast asleep!

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.player: I'm sorry, I didn't realise you were sleeping. I just wanted to say hello.

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.npc: Hello then. Can I help you with anything?

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.player: No, that's it. You can go back to sleep, sorry to have disturbed you.

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.npc: It's no problem.

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.text: Hannibal snuggles back down and is fast asleep in an instant.
(Future conversations with Hannibal will use response 2.)

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.npc: Hello [player name]. Did you need something?

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.player: Nothing important. I'd like to ask you a question if that is okay?

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.npc: Ask away.

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.player: Why did you pick the kitchen as your spot to sleep? It must get quite noisy sometimes?

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.npc: It does during meal times, but it's also lovely and warm near the fire, and look at all the food!

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.player: Good point. Now it seems like the best spot in the house!

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.npc: You catch on quickly, for a human! Now I am going to go back to sleep, unless there is something else I can help you with?

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.player: That was all I wanted to ask, thank you.

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.text: Hannibal curls up on the stool and goes back to sleep.
(Future conversations with Hannibal will use response 3.)

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.npc: Oh, hello [player name]. Did I hear a bark?

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.player: A bark? Is there a dog here?

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.npc: There is, sometimes...
It always wakes me up with its barking.
It seems to come and go. I can't figure out why or how.

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.player: That is indeed strange. I'll keep an eye out for it.

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.npc: There it is again, did you hear it?
Maybe I'm imagining it.

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.text: Hannibal settles back down and is sleeping in moments.
(Future conversations with Hannibal will use response 4.)

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.npc: Hi [player name].
I'm okay, thank you. I've been enjoying the piano playing. Was it you playing earlier?
Must have been Gem then. She often plays the piano when she thinks nobody is listening.
She's actually quite good.

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.player: I'll have to keep an ear out.

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.text: Hannibal stretches and goes back to sleep.
(Future conversations with Hannibal will use response 5.)

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.npc: Hi there, [player name].

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.player: I have another question for you, if that is okay?

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.npc: Go ahead.

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.player: Do you ever leave the hall? I've only ever seen you in here.

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.npc: I do sometimes. If I do go out, it's normally at night.
I much prefer it in here though. Nice and warm with good food. There is even a bank, if I ever needed a bank for anything.

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.player: That's fair enough. The world can be a pretty scary place out there anyway.

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.npc: Exactly. It's much nicer to relax here, even with the occasional adventurer disturbing me.

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.player: That'll be me! Sorry, I'll let you get back to sleep.

standard-dialogue-with-a-catspeak-amulet.text: Hannibal goes back to sleep, enjoying the warmth of the fire.
(Future conversations with Hannibal will use response 1.)

steps.text: He lets out a quiet purr before going back to resting.
You scratch Hannibal behind the ears...
He purrs contentedly before going back to sleep.

feeding-hannibal-selecting-the-feed-opti.player: I should give him some fish from my inventory!

feeding-hannibal-using-raw-fish-on-hanni.text: Hannibal gobbles up the fish, then settles back down to rest.

feeding-hannibal-using-raw-fish-on-hanni.npc: Thank you [player name]. That's very tasty, though it would be even more tasty if it was cooked.
I do. Why do you think I'm in the kitchen? All this lovely food being cooked all the time!

feeding-hannibal-using-raw-fish-on-hanni.player: That is a good point. I will see if I can find you something cooked.

feeding-hannibal-using-raw-fish-on-hanni.npc: I look forward to it. You know where to find me.

feeding-hannibal-using-raw-fish-on-hanni.text: Hannibal settles back down to sleep.

feeding-hannibal-using-cooked-fish-on-ha.npc: Thank you [player name]. That was lovely! Do you have any more?

feeding-hannibal-using-cooked-fish-on-ha.player: You just ate the entire thing, and you're still hungry?
I do often wake up hungry, maybe you're on to something.
I'll see if I can find you something else.

feeding-hannibal-using-cooked-fish-on-ha.npc: Lovely, I'll be right here, working hard.

feeding-hannibal-using-cooked-fish-on-ha.text: Hannibal settles back down to sleep.
